# OptionWorld

> Institutional-grade options analytics platform for Indian (NSE) markets — real-time option chain, PCR, OI analytics, max pain, strategy builder and simulator.

OptionWorld helps Indian options traders analyze the NSE derivatives market with real-time data, technical charts, and advanced options analytics.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of OptionWorld's dashboard and analytics.
- [About](/about): Our mission and what OptionWorld offers.
- [Plans](/plans): Subscription plans and pricing.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about the platform.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the OptionWorld team.
- [Documentation](/documentation): Feature and metric documentation.
- [Video Tutorials](/videos): Walkthroughs of key platform features.
- [NSE Holidays](/holidays): NSE market holidays.

## Analytics

- [Option Chain](/option-chain): Live NSE option chain with OI, IV and Greeks.
- [Option Heatmap](/option-heatmap): Visual heatmap of option activity.
- [PCR](/pcr): Put-Call Ratio dashboard.
- [Max Pain](/max-pain): Expiry-wise max pain analysis.
- [OI Across Expiries](/oi-across-expiries): Multi-expiry OI distribution.
- [OI Change Trend](/oi-change-trend): Intraday OI change trend.
- [Options Summary](/options-summary): All-in-one options metrics dashboard.
- [Strategy Builder](/option-builder): Build multi-leg option strategies.
- [Strategy Simulator](/option-simulator): Simulate strategy P&L over time.
- [Market Breadth](/market-breadth): Advance/decline and sector breadth.
- [FII Data](/fii): FII/DII derivatives activity.
- [Stock Screeners](/stock-screeners): Preset and custom stock scans.
